name: advisor
description: One fresh, read-only consultation for material technical decisions.

author.name: David Schmidt / Zero Delta LLC (maintainer); Daniel McAteer (original author)

interface.shortDescription: Read-only advice for material technical decisions.
interface.longDescription: Advisor implicitly matches material architecture, interface, data-model, compatibility, cross-boundary, diagnostic, security, privacy, authorization, migration, recovery, and irreversible-state decisions. The root declares consult or skip before implementation, selects one of two model-pinned read-only roles from the parent-model policy, verifies the exact completed spawn event, and records accept, modify, or reject. Luna and Spark parents use Advisor Terra; Terra, Sol, and unknown parents use Advisor Sol. Routine and borderline work skips consultation. Advice is non-authoritative, and the plugin never implements, routes work, or performs final review.
defaultPrompt: Use $advisor:consultation for a material technical decision.
Ask Advisor for a fresh, read-only second opinion.
